metadata.title: $ω$ Centauri: A MUSE discovery of a counter-rotating core

notes: No eligible stars: the paper studies the globular cluster ω Centauri and its stellar kinematics, and reports high-velocity stars only as an ensemble or without individual identifiers. It does not identify any star as a Galactic unbound candidate (see T:p12-b4 and T:p13-b1).
